Unauthorized Migration Change vs. Enforcement Actions

This Sankey diagram connects each country to the years where its estimated unauthorized population shifted, and then to the enforcement outcomes recorded for that year. Thickness reflects magnitude: the left bands represent year-over-year population changes (absolute values), while the right bands capture combined returns and removals. Link colour highlights direction of change—deep reds show increases, deep blues show decreases, and muted tones indicate limited movement.
